title: Chapter 505
text:
"What?"

"This — this is impossible!"

The sound of the headless corpse falling to the ground seemed to have smashed their hearts, and the expressions of all the prisoners changed!

This disfigured and burned person was a ferocious person with a fierce reputation. He had killed countless people, and his powerful strength made the other prisoners not dare to be negligent. Is this a Blue Star's' ship '? A spaceship?

Although they knew that Han Xiao was very strong, due to the lack of information and preconceived notions, Han Xiao was still a member of Blue Star in their eyes, and they had never thought of him as an alien. The appearance of this huge spaceship had shattered their worldview and exceeded their imagination!

They originally did not believe that the Six Nations had submitted to Han Xiao, but after seeing this scene, they could not help but be shaken.

The prisoners completely gave up on the idea of escaping and obediently lined up to board the spaceship with bitter faces. The ferocious thugs became docile sheep in front of Han Xiao.

The last prisoner passed by Han Xiao and suddenly stopped in front of the gangway. He turned to look at Han Xiao and hesitated. "Do you still remember me?"

Han Xiao paused and carefully sized up this prisoner. Suddenly, he was stunned. "You are … Hannes?"

"That's me." Hannes smiled bitterly.

"Why are you here? Bennett and I thought that you went missing!" Han Xiao had a surprised expression. There was a hidden mission in his interface that Hannes had issued. It was called 'Uncover the secrets behind Blue Star's history'.

Before Han Xiao left Blue Star, the mission had already reached the third round. However, because Hannes had suddenly disappeared, there were no further notifications. However, the mission had not failed, so he felt that Hannes should still be alive.

Hannes being locked up in Bell of Death Island was out of Han Xiao's expectations.

"It's a long story." Hannes shook his head helplessly. "I discovered a shocking secret, and this secret brought us danger. Everyone else died, and only I survived."

Han Xiao frowned and guessed. "You were locked up in Bell of Death Island, so this was done by the Six Nations? You discovered the secret that they wanted to hide? "

"No." Hannes shook his head. Hannes shook his head. "Although the Six Nations captured me, they saved my life when I was on the brink of death."

"… Then why were you captured?"

Hannes smiled bitterly. "Maybe it's because there was a dead Godora person lying beside me at that time."

"What?"

Han Xiao was shocked. "How did you meet a Godora person?"

"Sigh, let's talk on the spaceship … You even have a spaceship now...... Maybe you are the only one who can use the clues I found...."

Hannes clenched his fists. He could not suppress the anger in his voice.
